```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(lme4)
  library(simr)
  library(WebPower)
})

```



```{r}
set.seed(123)

cat('--- ASSUMPTIONS ---\n')
n_social <- 43
n_control <- 46
n_total <- n_social + n_control
n_stim <- 60
emotion_levels <- c('anger', 'disgust', 'fear', 'happy', 'neutral', 'sad')

# Fixed effects used throughout
main_social <- 0.30
happy_interaction <- 0.20
emotion_effects <- c(
  anger = 0.00,
  disgust = 0.10,
  fear = 0.00,
  happy = 0.05,
  neutral = -0.05,
  sad = 0.00
)
```

# Variance components

```{r}
# set some random structure parameters
participant_sd <- 0.30
stim_sd <- 0.10
resid_sd <- 1.00
stim_per_emotion <- 10

cat('n_total =', n_total, '\n')
cat('groups =', n_social, 'social,', n_control, 'control\n')
cat('n_stim =', n_stim, '\n')
cat('emotion_levels =', paste(emotion_levels, collapse = ', '), '\n')
cat('main_social =', main_social, '\n')
cat('happy_interaction =', happy_interaction, '\n')
cat('participant_sd =', participant_sd, '\n')
cat('stim_sd =', stim_sd, '\n')
cat('resid_sd =', resid_sd, '\n\n')

cat('--- PART 1: simr MIXED-MODEL SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ---\n')

# Build design used for simr
social_ids <- paste0('S', seq_len(n_social))
control_ids <- paste0('C', seq_len(n_control))
participant_order <- as.vector(rbind(c(social_ids, rep(NA, n_control - n_social)), control_ids))
participant_order <- participant_order[!is.na(participant_order)]

participant_df <- data.frame(
  participant = factor(participant_order, levels = participant_order),
  social = ifelse(grepl('^S', participant_order), 1, 0)
)

stim_df <- data.frame(
  stim = factor(seq_len(n_stim)),
  emotion = factor(rep(emotion_levels, each = 10), levels = emotion_levels)
)

dat <- merge(participant_df, stim_df, all = TRUE)
dat <- dat[order(dat$participant, dat$stim), ]

fixef_vec <- c(
  '(Intercept)' = 0.00,
  'social' = main_social,
  'emotiondisgust' = emotion_effects['disgust'],
  'emotionfear' = emotion_effects['fear'],
  'emotionhappy' = emotion_effects['happy'],
  'emotionneutral' = emotion_effects['neutral'],
  'emotionsad' = emotion_effects['sad'],
  'social:emotiondisgust' = 0.00,
  'social:emotionfear' = 0.00,
  'social:emotionhappy' = happy_interaction,
  'social:emotionneutral' = 0.00,
  'social:emotionsad' = 0.00
)

m1 <- makeLmer(
  y ~ social * emotion + (1 | participant) + (1 | stim),
  fixef = fixef_vec,
  VarCorr = list(
    participant = participant_sd^2,
    stim = stim_sd^2
  ),
  sigma = resid_sd,
  data = dat
)

#  run settings that are reasonable, given that this can takle a long time
ps_social <- powerSim(m1, test = fixed('social', method = 'z'), nsim = 100)
ps_happy <- powerSim(m1, test = fixed('social:emotionhappy', method = 'z'), nsim = 100)
```
